name: retrain-simulation
notes: ADR-0185: ONE staged document that trains, retrains and trades. Stages: calendar (locked development_outer) -> memory -> hpo_document + hpo (warmup HPO: the locked lean recipe's 24-candidate evidence-mode search, one-standard-error rule per lead, on fold 0's inner purged slice, which ends before 2022-05-01) -> winners (each lead's ruling re-derived from its attested trial ledger) -> walk_document + walk (the scheduled retraining: 20 releases, each FITTED on its trailing 730 days with a 5-day embargo, every 63 days, with the frozen winners and no search) -> inventory -> gates -> simulate (ADR-0184's publisher, per-tick EquityKellyMIO, next-bar-open fills and Schwab costs over folds 2..19 = 2022-09-09..2025-10-16, $10,000 + $500 every other Friday per cash-flow-policy-biweekly.json). DEVELOPMENTAL POST-SELECTION, deployment_eligible=false: the gate admission reads all 20 folds, and the warmup search's cohort and horizons come from the Gate-3 admission decided on the traded 2022-2025 folds (both look-ahead, disclosed). The MIO uses ADR-0185's owner-delegated growth policy v1; those values are judgement calls, not tuned optima or deployment validation. Predictions are computed in batch at fit time over each release's validation window, not by per-tick calls to a persisted model. Run from the child root: python -m dskit.pipeline staged configs/run-retrain-simulation.json --asof 2026-02-28 --adapter intraday_equities. A rerun of the same document resumes finished stages.

source_a.notes: alpaca-sip-split holds eleven P10 names and SPY; SPY is the reference every group build reads from this source under its own group universe bound.

params.provenance_waiver: Each immutable MarketRecord already carries its source; the five symbol namespaces are disjoint and checked below.

pooled.notes: Only source groups containing the 25 selected names are read; their symbol namespaces are disjoint and source_a also supplies SPY.

walkforward.notes: The locked development_outer schedule (A18623/ADR-0098), restated here only because the walk grammar needs it inline; WarmupHpoCandidate and FrozenWalkCandidate refuse any field that differs from $calendar.phase.walkforward. The warmup HPO walk narrows it to its FIRST fold; the frozen retraining walk runs all 20.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity - where metrics land is not what it computes.

calendar.notes: The locked development_outer schedule every later stage checks its walk against.

memory.notes: Build four bounded P13 group caches containing the frozen P12 feature matrix, label tape, and causal five-minute OHLCVA bars. The P12 caches remain untouched because write-once cache identity changes when K-lines are added. Groups D and E use P13 cohort-only universes plus SPY so unused P12 breadth candidates cannot inflate peak memory.

templates.feature_policy: all frozen P12 features except the exact P16 lean-mask drop (33 columns, pinned below and by tests/test_configs.py against intraday_equities.final_model.lean_feature_drop()); symbol_code is native categorical
templates.seed_policy: fixed seed 0; ADR-0115 evidence-mode selection over the same 24-trial purged inner CandidateInventory draw
templates.notes: ADR-0115: model-family and feature-mask selection are closed (master plan Sec.2), so the torch-mlp candidate is removed and this is the ONLY finalist recipe. estimator wraps ColumnSubsetEstimator around the same LightGBM the space was built for (2026-09-06 research, docs/research/zoo-feature-selection-and-hpo/), applying the exact P16 lean drop (docs/memos/p16-feature-mask-and-final-gate-results.md) so training reads the identical 33-fewer-column feature set P16 selected on. hpo_objective is squared_error_improvement (never IC, master plan Sec.2) with hpo_evidence=true, so per-lead selection runs ADR-0114 SS11 item 1's one-standard-error rule over a complete trial ledger instead of a raw argmin/argmax; hpo_trials/hpo_seed/hpo_val_days/hpo_embargo_days/hpo_space are UNCHANGED from the prior 'ic'-objective recipe — same 24-of-324 frozen inventory, same inner cuts. This template's id is 'lean' (not the prior 'lgbm'), matching P16's own winning candidate's mask-family component (P16 memo line 37) so FinalistCandidate's own id-plus-horizon-suffix recipe lookup resolves to the real winner BenchmarkSelect names -- this document restates no full candidate name itself. intraday_equities.final_model.hpo_space() was updated in the same change to match this template by family == 'pooled-lightgbm' rather than a fixed id, since id is now the finalist's candidate-name component, not a stable lookup key for the generic HPO-grid reader.

hpo_document.notes: The ONE locked recipe (run-final-hpo.json's lean template, byte-identical: P16's 33-column mask, 24-candidate CandidateInventory, hpo_evidence, squared_error_improvement, one-standard-error rule) with its walk narrowed to the schedule's first fold. Its search reads only that fold's training window (inner 63-day slice, 5-day embargo), so no tuned setting sees a traded day. Look-ahead, disclosed: the search's rows precede the traded window, but the cohort, each lead's scored names and the horizon weights come from the pinned Gate-3 admission, which was decided on the P12 walk over the same 2022-2025 folds the simulation trades, so the traded window influenced WHICH names and leads were searched (look-ahead in the cohort, disclosed; developmental post-selection).

hpo.notes: Actual fits: 10 leads x 24 candidates on the warmup window, checkpointed and evidence-sealed.

winners.notes: Each lead's winner re-derived from its attested hpo_ledger with the same one-standard-error rule FinalRefit uses; nothing is read from a pasted value.

walk_document.notes: The same recipe with every hpo_* knob removed and each lead's estimator_params = recipe base + its frozen winner; the full 20-fold schedule.

walk.notes: The scheduled retraining: one fit per release (fold), trailing 730 days, 5-day embargo, every 63 days.

inventory.notes: Seals every release's saved predictions into the manifest the gates and the publisher verify.

gates.notes: P16 gate math unchanged (Bonferroni over every unit); reads THIS run's inventory artifact, never a pasted pin.

simulate.notes: Runs the ADR-0184 decision graph (template) with the publisher bound to this run's inventory and gates artifacts; outputs land under this run's stages/ directory.
